goal: Phone video -> photoreal, walkable 3D of the REAL room. Real pixels first, 3D model for in-between views, generation only for holes (flagged). Free GPUs.
now: Trained 3D model (gsplat) on the 162 cameras that agree (namma-model, ~35 min). Viewer: 3D fill behind photos (done).

phases.name: A. Capture & cameras
steps: Metric depth (Depth Anything 3) aligned to cameras
Camera check on every frame: median 34.3 dB, 89 wrong (corridor look-alikes)
Re-check with 507 cameras: held-out 27.0 -> 30.4 dB, SSIM 0.90; but 28 more bad frames surfaced
Stricter check: 319/596 cameras kept, all >= 20 dB; held-out 30.7 dB / SSIM 0.91; off-path coverage 94%
Recover dropped frames (re-place them against the verified cameras) - 46% of frames dropped
Cross-pass check: passes disagree (11-17 dB; door rebuilt as window) - look-alike places fooled the global solve
Pass grouping: 10 passes -> 5 groups that agree (biggest: 4 passes, 198 frames); nothing moved
Bridges + whole-group check: cross-pass median 15.7 -> 28.2 dB; 2 groups (162 + 94 frames)
Run 6: group 0 = 4 passes, 162 frames, cross-pass median 30.8 dB (453-488: 28.2 -> 30.8 with ICP); other passes stay apart (13-20 dB)

phases.name: B. Quick proofs (5-10 min each)
steps: P1 real-pixel rebuild: 27.0 dB, SSIM 0.86 (splats 18.8) - PASSED
P2 Tencent WorldMirror demo: right room, streaky - shape only
P3 Difix repair: small effect - final polish only
P4 run 2: run 1 invented a door/screen/figure in a big hole (one pass as source). Now: all aligned passes first, model fills small gaps only, big unfilmed areas never invented

phases.name: C. Final build
steps: 3D model (gsplat, SH3; default + MCMC 1.5M) trained ONLY on cameras that agree (group 0)
Floor plan + walkable grid from group-0 geometry
Real-photo viewer + fused 3D fill behind the photos; instant splat (no training) of group 0

phases.name: D. Later
steps: Techfest R1 (31 Oct): draft abstract + video storyboard in docs/TECHFEST_R1.md; filming guide docs/CAPTURE_GUIDE.md

results: 30.8 dB median (was 15.7 before the pass fix)
